summary: This directory manages the core entity definition system, providing tools for schema generation, data validation, and structural management. It centralizes CRUD schema definitions, field metadata, and type-safe data conversion utilities for consistent application-wide data modeling.
responsibilities: Defining and generating CRUD schemas for domain entities
Providing reusable field definitions and metadata configurations
Implementing data conversion and serialization logic for entities
Handling specialized data types such as localized dates
Validating data structures against entity schema definitions
Analyzing schema ASTs for error reporting and field mapping
relationships: Entity definitions serve as the foundational schema models used by CRUD generators to create insert, update, and select operations.
Field definitions provide the granular constraints and metadata that constitute the structure of an entity.
The data conversion utilities rely on schema definitions to safely encode and decode data between external formats and internal types.
The AST matcher interacts with schema structures to resolve and flatten validation errors into field-specific issues.
designDecisions: Use of schema-based definitions to derive CRUD operations and UI annotations consistently.
Type branding for specialized domain types to ensure runtime and compile-time data integrity.
Integration of Effect-based patterns for robust error handling during encoding and decoding.
Centralization of business entity definitions to maintain a single source of truth for domain models.
